title: 第536章 真凤之羽九曲天音第535章 惊艳三十三天真凤始祖转世
slug: 八年质子归京岂知天下已刻吾名
lines: 凤血仙池之上。
黎清月的神魂，扶摇而上，进入了一处被无尽岁月遗忘的世外苍茫之中。
这里没有日月星辰，甚至脱离了仙界世外。
这里，只有无尽的枯寂与虚无。
然而。
在这虚无世外，却存在着一座座宛若羽翼一般的世外山海！
这一座座世外山海，远远看去，好似无数片闪烁着神圣光辉的真羽，静静地沉浮在这片苍茫之间。
如果，近距离去凝视，便会骇然的发现。
这些真羽所化的世外山海之上，赫然存在着一个个世界。
这些世界，彼此之间被黑暗阻断，无法相连。
但每一处世界之上，都存在有文明。
只不过，这些文明，皆处在部落原始时代，还用着石刻，以狩猎为生。
纵然修炼，所修炼的道路，也是通过石刻之上的图腾来修。
黎清月看到这一幕，内心掀起惊涛骇浪！
她可以肯定，眼前这一处处世界之上的生灵，绝对不属于苍茫中的任何一处，甚至也不属于仙界。
她更可以肯定，这一处处世界的本体，正是真凤之羽所化！
一羽！
一世界！
这些世界，皆因真凤之羽所生。
而他们所修炼的石刻图腾，也皆传承之真凤残留。
这是存在于，真凤之羽之上的世界！
以真凤之羽，化世外苍茫山海……
这，就是真凤一族的起源所在吗！
这些真羽世界，在这片虚无中沉浮了不知多少个岁月，每一片真羽之上，都承载着一个世界的生灭，化作了一片片独立而浩瀚的世界。
黎清月的身影，便静静地盘坐在这片世外苍茫的正中央。
她并没有去靠近，因为那些真凤之羽世界，距离她很远。
而她同样能够感受到，无论那些世界有多么遥远，都与她所在的这里相连。
因为，自己所在的地方，便是这些真羽世界的核心所在！
如果说，那些真羽世界，只是真凤之羽所化，那么眼下她所在的地方，便是真凤本体！
黎清月双眸紧闭，周身萦绕着真凤赤霞的光辉，整个人仿佛与这片虚无融为了一体。
在她的正前方，一条古老而神秘的起源古路，自虚无中延伸而出，直通那不可知的至高之处。
尽头，朦胧而黑暗。
但，黎清月依旧感应的清清楚楚。
这条古路，一共九千阶。
每一阶，都仿佛跨越了万古的时空，散发着令人心悸的无上威压。
“上去！”
黎清月缓缓睁开了双眼，她的眼中，没有一丝迷茫，只有前所未有的坚定。
content_en:
Above the Phoenix Blood Immortal Pond.
Li Qingyue's spirit soared upwards and entered a vast world forgotten by endless years.
There are no sun, moon or stars here, and it is even separated from the fairy world.
Here, there is only endless silence and nothingness.
However.
In this world of nothingness, there are mountains and seas outside the world that are like wings!
Seen from a distance, these out-of-this-world mountains and seas look like countless pieces of true feathers shining with divine brilliance, quietly sinking and floating in this vast expanse.
If you look closely, you will be shocked to find out.
Above the mountains and seas outside the world that these real feathers have transformed into, worlds clearly exist.
These worlds are blocked by darkness and cannot be connected to each other.
But in every world, there is civilization.
However, these civilizations were all in the primitive era of tribes, and they still used stone carvings and made a living by hunting.
Even when practicing, the path of cultivation is cultivated through the totems on the stone carvings.
When Li Qingyue saw this scene, his heart was filled with turmoil!
She was certain that the creatures in the world before her definitely did not belong to anywhere in the vastness, not even to the fairy world.
She is even more certain that the essence of this world is transformed from the feathers of the true phoenix!
One feather!
One world!
These worlds are all born from the feathers of the true phoenix.
And the stone totems they cultivated are all remnants of the inherited True Phoenix.
This is the world that exists above the True Phoenix Feather!
With the feathers of a true phoenix, the vast mountains and seas in the world are transformed...
Is this the origin of the Zhenfeng clan?
These true feather worlds have been floating in this void for countless years. Each true feather carries the birth and death of a world, turning into independent and vast worlds.
Li Qingyue's figure sat quietly in the middle of this vast world.
She didn't get close, because those worlds of True Phoenix Feather were far away from her.
And she can also feel that no matter how far away those worlds are, they are all connected to where she is.
Because the place where you are is the core of these real feather worlds!
If those real feather worlds were just transformed by the feathers of the real phoenix, then where she is now is the true phoenix itself!
Li Qingyue closed her eyes tightly, her whole body was surrounded by the brilliance of Zhenfeng Chixia, and her whole body seemed to be integrated with this void.
Directly in front of her, an ancient and mysterious origin road extended from nothingness, leading directly to the unknowable highest place.
The end is hazy and dark.
However, Li Qingyue still felt it clearly.
This ancient road has a total of nine thousand steps.
Each level seemed to span eternity of time and space, exuding a heart-stopping and supreme pressure.
"Go up!"
Li Qingyue slowly opened her eyes. There was no trace of confusion in her eyes, only determination that she had never seen before.
